PreInvocation.command: [ -n "${WT_SESSION:-}" ] && [ -n "${WT_COM_CLSID:-}" ] && command -v powershell.exe >/dev/null 2>&1 && WTA_HOOK_CWD="$PWD" WSLENV="${WSLENV:+$WSLENV:}WSL_DISTRO_NAME/w:WTA_HOOK_CWD/w" powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -EncodedCommand  || printf '{}\n'; exit 0
